scope: Real R12 profile controls and derived mobile presentation

checks.name: Measured handoff control properties
checks.observation: The before check failed for avatar weight/size, label weight, field/upload fills, helper line height, save weight/padding/opacity and mobile font size. After checks pass on desktop/mobile.

checks.name: Geometry
checks.observation: Measured desktop control boxes match immutable HTML within 0.02 px rounding. Mobile input text is 16 px, actions are 44 px and save button retains 16 px bottom padding inside the card.

checks.name: Controlled frozen-reference pixels
checks.observation: Full MAE 3.582 to 2.095; complete card bounds MAE 5.342 to 0.571. PNG hash unchanged. Actual/diff/overlay and hashes are in the visual report.

checks.name: Real profile browser flows
checks.observation: Save name through existing PATCH, open security tab and close to workspace pass on both viewports. No page errors. Production handlers unchanged.

checks.name: Native Web validation
checks.observation: Profile 2 files/9 tests and full Web 297 files/940 tests pass. TypeScript/Vite production build and git diff --check pass.

checks.name: Full-design 1:1 and physical media acceptance
checks.observation: Remaining visual differences prevent strict equality. Mobile profile has no separate PNG golden; fixture checks do not prove server ACL or physical media.
